inApp.title: Open Late Winner in your browser to keep your career
inApp.why: You're in an app's own browser: a career started here stays here, and Google sign-in doesn't work.
inApp.whyCareer: Your career only lives in this app's browser: you won't find it in your own browser or on another device.
inApp.steps: Tap the app's ⋯ menu, then choose to open the page in your browser.
inApp.stepsCareer: Copy your resume link, then paste it into the address bar of Safari or Chrome: your career opens there.
inApp.copied: Link copied · it works once, for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
inApp.copyByHand: Copy this link · it works once, for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
inApp.unavailable: Link unavailable right now. Try again in a moment.

resume.title: Pick up your career
resume.moreCareers: {count, plural, one {And # other career} other {And # other careers}}

ready.heading: Pick up your career here
ready.text: This link opens your career in this browser. It also stays in the app where you started it.

here.heading: Your career is already here
here.text: This browser already has this career: nothing to do.

account.heading: This browser is signed in with Google
account.text: To keep things apart, the link doesn't open on a Google account. Open it in another browser, or sign out first.

other-career.heading: This browser already has a career
other-career.text: So as not to replace it, the link doesn't open here. Open it in another browser.

used.heading: This link has already been used
used.text: Your career is in the browser where you opened it. For a new link, go back to your career and copy it again.

expired.heading: This link has expired
expired.text: A resume link lasts {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}. Go back to your career, where you started it, and copy a new link.

unknown.heading: This link doesn't work
unknown.text: It's incomplete or doesn't exist. Check that you pasted all of it.
